what: LONG-TAIL BATCH F, STEP 2 — a pivot that takes the last body down does not pivot: the battle is won in runAction before the switch request is made.
written: 2026-09-06, BEFORE the measuring run, by ENGINE.
the_rule: sim/battle.ts:2832-2833 — `this.faintMessages(); if (this.ended) return true;` — sits ABOVE the switch block at :2874 and the `makeRequest('switch')` at :2906. That faintMessages takes its DEFAULT checkWin=true, unlike the one inside the hit loop (scripts.ts:547, called as faintMessages(false,false,!pokemon.hp)). So a selfSwitch flag set by a wiping KO is never turned into a switch.
probe: tests/probe_pivot_after_battle_end.js, knob MEDI_PIVOT_AFTER_BATTLE_END. Shown RED first: every fixture and authority assertion green, and exactly the engine assertions red — medicham2 pivots 1x where the authority pivots 0x, and the wiping game parts on `|switch|p1a: Absol|absol, L50|140/140|[from] uturn` past the end of showdown's stream.
which_scoreboard: THE POOL. Flip Turn is 5,659 sheets and U-turn 2,273; both rows are pinned-pool games. The census and roster are expected to sit still — no tag changes and the roster stages no side wipe.
why_two: The by-cause table on c273d4301fd1 carries exactly two board-parted rows of this shape, one game each: `showdown stopped emitting while medicham2 continued :: |switch|p2a|pelipper,l50|H/H` (SHARED-COIN) and `... :: |switch|p1a|archaludon,l50|H/H` (instrument-suspect).
why_it_might_miss_HIGH: Both games END at that line in the authority, so there is nothing left for them to re-part on — the batch-D/E re-parting mechanism has less room here than in step 1. If it still misses high, the cause is a game outside these two whose first divergence moved.
why_it_might_miss_LOW: A wiping pivot could be the SECOND divergence in some other game whose first divergence closes later; that would show up as a bigger drop than 2 only in a later step, not here.
